# onlineornot_checks (Data Source)

Fetches the list of uptime checks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List resources from a project and resources without a project.
data "onlineornot_checks" "selected" {
  project_ids = ["a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8", "unassigned"]
}

# Existing single-project filters are also supported.
data "onlineornot_checks" "one_project" {
  project_id = "a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Filter by one project ID, or unassigned for resources without a project. Omit both project_id and project_ids to list across all projects. Cannot be combined with project_ids.
- `project_ids` (List of String) Filter by up to 100 project IDs. Include unassigned for resources without a project. Omit both project_id and project_ids to list across all projects. Cannot be combined with project_id.

### Read-Only

- `checks` (Attributes List) List of uptime checks (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--checks))

<a id="nestedatt--checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `checks`

Read-Only:

- `check_type` (String) The type of check (GET, POST, etc.). Must be one of: `BROWSER`, `DNS`, `TCP`, `UPTIME`.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the check
- `method` (String) The HTTP method used
- `name` (String) The name of the check
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID. Null for unassigned.
- `status` (String) The current status of the check. Must be one of: `DOWN`, `MAINTENANCE`, `MUTED`, `PAUSED`, `PENDING`, `RECOVERING`, `UP`, `VERIFYING`.
- `url` (String) The URL being monitored
